stem:
Lalit compares the decimals $0.09$ and $0.1$.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly compare them by place value?

options.text: Call the answer the phrase first unequal digit, and stop with no places compared.
Align place values as $0.09$ and $0.10$; in the tenths place $1 > 0$, so $0.1 > 0.09$.
$0.1$ is greater than $0.09$, because one tenth is greater than zero tenths and nine hundredths.
$0.09 > 0.1$ because $0.09$ has more digits written after the decimal point.

teacher.key_rationale: Align as 0.09 and 0.10. Tenths digits 0 vs 1 decide that 0.1 is greater. Digit-count after the decimal and a bare label both miss place-value comparison.
